verification_method: Reviewed original build_model.py; independent reviewer_verify.py imports neither builder classifier nor QA code. Independently parsed binary STL and 3MF XML, checked exact ordered triangles and full-face materials, constructed analytic 48-gon finite vertical planes using segment endpoints and all three vertices, z bounds and outward winding. No radial-only final selection, centroid shortcut, subdivision or guessed per-pixel paint.
scout_reconciliation: Initial 105 indices exactly reproduce abs(normal_z)<1e-5. All three extra small faces 2640/2758/2876 lie wholly on finite outer facet 44; normal_z=-1.03803659e-5 barely exceeds early cutoff while maximum plane error is only 1.23669355e-6 mm. 108 correct final faces = 36 each of three layers; this is not expansion to inner or mixed surfaces.
appearance_limits: Green #3C9860 and neutral #AAA79F are opaque uncalibrated display proxies, not measured paint/material specifications.

Only 108 original outer vertical faces colored; 2896 neutral. Inner arc, caps, underside, side seals, balcony platforms, glazing, sign wall, left tower, horizontal facade bands, hidden lower/rear/roof surfaces remain unresolved.
Original balcony positions/proportions, backed wall simplification and missing upper thin dark railings are inherited; limited coloring does not certify detailed source-accurate geometry.
No camera clipping found visually; independent orthographic projection confirmed all vertices within all five frames. Camera labels are model viewpoints, not geographic evidence.
